description: Watch ops — spawn background pollers for external sources (MRs, jobs, calendar) that emit events via UDS socket + status files + macOS notifications. Reusable foundation; channel consumer plugs in later.

watch.description: Spawn a background poller for SOURCE:ID. Optional :only=ev1,ev2 filters which events emit notifications. PID file: /tmp/supertool-watch-{SOURCE}__{ID}.pid

unwatch.description: Kill the poller for SOURCE:ID and remove its PID file.

watches.description: List active watch pollers as a table: source, id, started, last_event, pid.
